full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs are the appellants in this Second Appeal. Their case in short is that Suit Dag Nos. 1402 and 1405 as shown in the plaint-schedule originally belonged to Upendra Nath Ghose and Dhirendra Nath Ghose in equal shares. The Ghose brothers jama settled .50 acre of land from Dag No. 1403 to Aswini Kumar Biswas, father of plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and husband of plaintiff No. 3 by registered kabala dated 4.11.42 A. D. at a jama of Tk. 4/50 on receipt of Tk. 100/- as selami. This Aswini Kumar also took jama settlement of the remaining .67 acre as stated in the plaint from Dag No. 1402 and .27 acre from Dag No. 1405 in the benami of his mother Sadhana Bala Biswas by a registered lease deed Ext 1 dated 23.1.45 A. D. at a jama of Tk. 13/00 and as selami of Tk. 1000/- only. Aswini Kumar had possessed the above lands taken by bandabasta since the time of jama settlement. Sadhana died in 1950 A. D. in Jessore Town. Then Aswini Kumar also died in May, 1951 A. D. Further case of the plaintiffs is that the plaintiffs and their predecessors are members of the Christian Community living in Jessore for a long period. The rent-roll relating to the plaintIand has been prepared showing plaintiff  Nos. 1 and 2 having 8 annas share and Jnanendra Biswas, the youngest brother of Aswini Kumar, having 8/- annas share. The said entry in the record of right is wrong and that Jnanendra has never possessed the suit-land as he has been living in India as an Indian national since 1932.
